title: Path Painter
release_notes: Launch build: 60+ handcrafted levels, Daily Puzzle, color-gate sequencing, switches, one-way and crumble tiles, optional timers, hints/undos, accessible colorblind palettes and high-contrast mode, haptics, offline-friendly play, and IAP for remove-ads, coins, and cosmetics. Performance and stability optimizations included.
full_description:
Relaxing yet smart swipe-to-paint puzzles in bite-sized levels. Draw a continuous path to fill tiles, unlock color gates in sequence, and flip switches to open new routes. Each level is a quick brain-teaser you can finish in under a minute, with cozy visuals, satisfying haptics, and accessible colorblind patterns.

Why you’ll love it:
- Satisfying swipe-to-paint mazes with crisp feedback
- Gate logic and color sequencing for deeper strategy
- Quick levels (30–120s) perfect for one-handed play
- Optional timers and stars for extra challenge
- Daily Puzzle and chapter map progression
- Accessible: high-contrast mode and colorblind palettes with patterns
- Offline-friendly; play anywhere

Helpful tools:
- Free 1-step undo; more via coins or rewarded ads
- Hints, +30s time, and ghost path preview
- Reset anytime if you want a fresh start

Fair and friendly:
- Free to play with optional ads and IAP (remove ads, cosmetics, coin packs)
- No loot boxes or pay-to-win—cosmetics only

Master the path, crack the sequence, and paint the board!
